records.name: Circulation Pump
records.inventory_icon: item model circulation_pump (merged housing + rotor, static)

kinetic.block_class: DirectionalAxisKineticBlock (facing = outlet, axis_along_first selects the shaft axis perpendicular to facing)
kinetic.shaft_faces: both faces on the rotation axis (hasShaftTowards: face.axis == rotation axis)
kinetic.axis: perpendicular to the fluid axis; 2 options per facing
kinetic.placement: 6 facings x 2 shaft orientations; facing defaults to looking direction, shift reverses
kinetic.rotating: circulation_pump_rotor partial: Create shaft (create:block/axis) plus two brass drive hubs on the shaft faces
kinetic.stationary: housing, copper pipe body, red outlet and blue inlet flanges
kinetic.direction: rotor turns exactly with network speed and direction (Create SingleAxisRotatingVisual / KineticBlockEntityRenderer); 1:1 with input shaft
kinetic.renderer: Flywheel visual SingleAxisRotatingVisual.of(CIRCULATION_PUMP_ROTOR); fallback BER AxialRotorRenderer when visualization is unsupported

records.name: Steam Turbine
records.inventory_icon: item model steam_turbine (merged housing + rotor, static)

kinetic.role: generator (GeneratingKineticBlockEntity). Prototype: runs on hot primary coolant passing through it (steam circuit not built yet); 16 RPM whenever it has heat
kinetic.impact_su: capacity = delivered heat x 4 SU per HU/t (CMThermal.SU_PER_HEAT), independent of RPM; 0 with no delivered heat
kinetic.shaft_faces: both end plates on the axis
kinetic.placement: axis follows player look; prefers adjoining shafts
kinetic.rotating: steam_turbine_rotor partial: Create shaft plus bladed disc visible through the slotted window
kinetic.stationary: end plates, riveted drum, slotted window band, steam inlet (top) and exhaust (bottom) flanges
kinetic.direction: rotor follows network speed and direction 1:1

issues: Prototype: powered by hot primary coolant, not steam. The steam circuit, heat exchanger and condenser come later (tsk-017 onward).

records.name: Instrumentation Panel
issues: Needles and lamps are static artwork, drawn at rest/unlit: there is no controller link or telemetry yet.

records.name: Control Rod Drive

kinetic.block_class: HorizontalKineticBlock (blockstate 'facing'; front = latch lever, faces the player when placed)
kinetic.rotating: control_rod_drive_pinion partial: half shaft from the back face plus the pinion gear
kinetic.stationary: base plate, brass housing, red latch, rack (drawn at the stored full-insertion position; rod movement is not implemented)
kinetic.direction: pinion follows network speed and direction 1:1; the rack does not move because insertion control is not implemented (M4 tasks)
kinetic.renderer: Flywheel OrientedRotatingVisual (UP to input side); fallback BER InputSideRotorRenderer

issues: The rack is static: rod insertion control is not implemented.

records.name: Reinforced Pipe
records.state_notes: six connection booleans from real neighbours (pipes, coolant port fronts, pump fluid axis, turbine top/bottom, relief valve back, PipeConnectable blocks); multipart core + arms. Does not transport fluid yet.
issues: Carries coolant for a pump loop (prototype): pipes hold no fluid of their own and a loop must be a single path without branches.

issues: First-person sleeves are not applicable: vanilla does not render armor on first-person arms.

Slim (Alex) model: checked in the 1.21.1 client code, not with an Alex skin in game. PlayerRenderer bakes PLAYER_SLIM_INNER/OUTER_ARMOR for slim players, and LayerDefinitions registers them with the same layer definitions as the wide model, so the outfit geometry and texture are identical.
